items.problem: Keyboard capture calls "the command of 3" again between text input elements, and gamepad focus check step 1 (qa-core.md:140) calls "the command of 3" then `set_input_device` and `list_ui`. Neither waits for the settle condition of step 3. A reopened panel or popup is still in a UICore flow with a `ui` reason tag block (ui-core.md:153, :188), so the next `tap` or `pad_button_down` can land during the open tween and be blocked, or `list_ui` can read moving rects. This existed with the earlier fixed `settleMs` wait as well, so it was not caused by this diff

The contrast condition measures text that another UI element fully covers, when no dim is above it. It skips only `dimmed`, and has no condition for `modal_covered` or for being drawn under another element. The UI properties default to modal on and dim off (ui-core.md:128), and `SceneUI` stays drawn under a panel, so `SceneUI` or panel text under an opaque panel or popup with dim off is measured on the pixels of the element on top. On a uniform plate, the median and the 99.9th percentile luminance are equal, the ratio is 1, it is under `minContrast` (schema default 3), and the UI quality check fails for text the player cannot see. This existed before the range; the same spec line now excludes only the dimmed case of it.
